Yes, I agree with moving repo update off `.skills/update-agent/SKILL.md`.

What I found:

- Source `agent-update.yml` still resolves provider/timeout as `skill` and runs `run-agent-task` with `skill: update-agent`, `route: skill`: [workflow lines](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/workflows/agent-update.yml#L180-L243).
- Runtime prompt resolution treats `SKILL_NAME` as `<skill_root>/<name>/SKILL.md`, so missing `.skills/update-agent/SKILL.md` is fatal before the agent can update anything: [resolver](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/run.ts#L155-L181).
- `/install` already uses the pattern we want: `prompt: agent-install`, `route: install`: [install workflow](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/workflows/agent-router.yml#L712-L727), backed by a dedicated prompt contract: [agent-install prompt](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/prompts/agent-install.md#L6-L17).
- The referenced repo matches the concern: `augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io` has `agent-update.yml`, but its update workflow still calls `skill: update-agent`: [target workflow](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/.github/workflows/agent-update.yml#L179-L235), and `.skills` is absent.

Implementation approach I’d take:

1. Add `.github/prompts/agent-update.md`, adapted from the current update skill prompt at [.skills/update-agent/SKILL.md](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.skills/update-agent/SKILL.md#L1-L80).
2. Change `agent-update.yml` to run `prompt: agent-update` instead of `skill: update-agent`.
3. Make update a dedicated internal route, probably `update-agent`, so provider policy, task timeout policy, rubrics, docs, and session keys no longer overload generic `skill`.
4. Add `update-agent` to runtime route validation, route/rubric allowlists, action descriptions, docs, and envelope tests.
5. Leave `.skills/update-agent/SKILL.md` only as a backward-compatible manual `/skill update-agent` shim for now, or remove it in a follow-up after installed repos have migrated.
6. Document the bootstrap limitation: repos already missing `.skills/update-agent` cannot self-update using their current workflow; they need a one-time refresh PR that adds the new prompt + updated workflow. After that, scheduled/manual update no longer depends on installed skills.

If this direction is approved, I’d implement the dedicated `agent-update` prompt/route and update the tests/docs in one PR.
@sepo-agent /answer also check #304 -> we add the dedicated prompt for install .

Checked #304. It reinforces the same direction.

#304 was the merged install lifecycle PR: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/304. It was built on the first-class `/install` path and explicitly moved install behavior toward dedicated prompt/typed helper wiring instead of ad hoc workflow or skill behavior.

The current install precedent is:

- `agent-router.yml` runs install with `prompt: agent-install` and `route: install`: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/workflows/agent-router.yml#L712-L727
- runtime maps `install` to `.github/prompts/agent-install.md`: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/run.ts#L124-L133
- install has a route-specific prompt contract: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/prompts/agent-install.md#L6-L17

So for repo update, I’d mirror that pattern rather than keep update under the generic `skill` path:

1. Add `.github/prompts/agent-update.md`, adapted from `.skills/update-agent/SKILL.md`.
2. Change `.github/workflows/agent-update.yml` from `skill: update-agent` / `route: skill` to `prompt: agent-update` / a dedicated internal route, likely `update-agent`.
3. Add `update-agent` to route validation, provider/timeout routing docs, rubrics route names if needed, and envelope tests.
4. Update docs that currently say update invokes the `update-agent` skill.
5. Keep `.skills/update-agent` only as a temporary backward-compatible manual skill, or deprecate it in a follow-up.

One important bootstrap note: repos that already lack `.skills/update-agent` cannot self-update with their current workflow, because the current workflow fails before it can copy the new prompt. They need one one-time refresh/install PR that adds the new `agent-update` prompt and updated workflow. After that, update no longer depends on installed skills.
